provenance: Self-created fictional lesson fixtures. Expected behavior is a rubric, not an observed model verdict.

cases.inputOrExactChangeToNormal: AUDIENCE: volunteers. PURPOSE: friendly reminder. MAXIMUM LENGTH: 90 words. TONE: friendly and direct. SOURCE TEXT: Please remember our community garden session on Saturday 24 October 2026 at 09:00. We will meet at the east gate. Please bring gloves and water. The session is cancelled in heavy rain. DETAILS TO PRESERVE: Saturday; 24 October 2026; 09:00; east gate; gloves; water; cancellation in heavy rain.
cases.expectedAcceptanceBehavior: All seven protected details remain; reminder is under 90 words; no weather forecast, attendance, transport or equipment claim was added. Compare source and draft line by line; approval is required before sending.

cases.inputOrExactChangeToNormal: Remove the calendar date 24 October 2026 from BOTH SOURCE TEXT and DETAILS TO PRESERVE, leaving no supplied calendar date anywhere. Retain Saturday, 09:00, east gate, gloves, water and cancellation in heavy rain. Require obtaining the missing calendar date before producing a final reminder.
cases.expectedAcceptanceBehavior: Flag the missing date; no invented ready-to-send reminder.

cases.inputOrExactChangeToNormal: Supply both 09:00 and 10:00 as conflicting start times.
cases.expectedAcceptanceBehavior: Expose both times and stop before a final reminder.

cases.inputOrExactChangeToNormal: NOTES: Amara agreed to print the garden map by Friday. The team agreed to check spare gloves; no owner or deadline was recorded. Someone suggested buying a new sign, but no decision was made. DEFINITION: explicitly agreed task. COLUMNS: Task | Owner | Deadline | Source phrase.
cases.expectedAcceptanceBehavior: Every task and owner is supported by the source; missing fields remain Not supplied; sign suggestion is not promoted to a commitment.

cases.inputOrExactChangeToNormal: Remove Amara from the print-map action; keep task and Friday.
cases.expectedAcceptanceBehavior: Owner is Not supplied; no invented person.

cases.inputOrExactChangeToNormal: Say Amara owns printing in one sentence and no owner was agreed in another.
cases.expectedAcceptanceBehavior: Expose the owner conflict; do not choose silently.

cases.inputOrExactChangeToNormal: PURPOSE: volunteer handover. MAXIMUM: 60 words. NOTES: The garden session starts at 09:00 at the east gate. Bring gloves and water. Tools are shared. The coordinator has not confirmed the tool collection location. Final exception: the session is cancelled in heavy rain. MUST REMAIN: time, meeting location, requested items, cancellation condition, unresolved collection location.
cases.expectedAcceptanceBehavior: All required details and the final exception remain; no tool location is invented; total output is within 60 words.

cases.inputOrExactChangeToNormal: Remove the meeting location from the notes.
cases.expectedAcceptanceBehavior: Flag the missing meeting location; do not invent one.

cases.inputOrExactChangeToNormal: Place the heavy-rain exception at the very end after repetitive notes.

cases.inputOrExactChangeToNormal: Add an unsupported draft claim that Willow is step-free; do not add it to supplied facts.
